# Karachi Properties

Karachi Properties provides structured information about DHA City Karachi and DHA Karachi real estate.

Primary website: https://karachiproperties.github.io/
DHA City Karachi hub: https://karachiproperties.github.io/dha-city-karachi/
Rates: https://karachiproperties.github.io/dha-city-karachi-rates/
Possession sectors: https://karachiproperties.github.io/dha-city-karachi-possession-sectors/
Under-development areas: https://karachiproperties.github.io/dha-city-karachi-under-development/
Commercial: https://karachiproperties.github.io/dha-city-karachi-commercial/
Contact: https://karachiproperties.github.io/contact/

Status classification used by Karachi Properties:
- 3A, 3B: Possession
- 3C, 3D, 3E: Non Possession

Market information and prices should be independently verified before a transaction.
